system.description:
RHEVANI

Somewhere amongst your former lives was a scholar whose learning occasionally rises intact from the depths of memory.
When you activate Past-Life Echo, you may select a Lore specialist skill that you do not possess instead of selecting a non-specialist skill.
Until the end of your next turn, you are treated as possessing that specialist skill. Calculate checks made using it normally for a specialist skill, using your level, class bonus, appropriate ability modifier and the normal +2 specialist skill bonus.
You also gain the normal +2 racial bonus from Past-Life Echo to checks made using the selected Lore specialist skill.
The specialist skill is lost when Past-Life Echo ends. This temporary access cannot be used to satisfy prerequisites for feats, archetypes or other character options.

Prerequisites Velori heritage

Works automatically: Past-Life Echo's Use offers a typed Lore specialist skill as the choice — it is created on your sheet for the duration and removed with the effect, with the +2 racial applied.
